verdict.rationale: Postmark's Domains API documents endpoints to verify DKIM, Return-Path and SPF records and to rotate DKIM keys, so API-driven domain verification is a first-party capability. The evidence never shows the product generating the exact DNS record values, and DMARC appears only as a paid per-domain monitoring add-on, not as record generation or verification. Missing for 10: evidence of generated SPF/DKIM DNS record values, DMARC record generation/verification, explicit verification-status fields in API responses, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate my sending domain end to end — the product generates the exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifies them, and exposes verification status via the API

citations.quote: Verify DKIM \- Verify Return-Path \- Verify an SPF record
